item.title: Transformative Impact of the Metaverse on Sustainability and Innovative Business Models
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the transformative potential of the metaverse in addressing sustainability challenges and enabling innovative business models. The metaverse represents an emerging digital frontier with significant implications for how organizations operate, create value, and engage with environmental and social considerations.
